Soni Company Secretary and Compliance Officer Membership No. FCS7063 Encl.: As above Zydus Sunshine Lifesciences signs agreement with Board of Investment, Sri Lanka to establish a pharmaceutical manufacturing facility in Sri Lanka Ahmedabad, India, 15 October, 2026 Dear Sir/Madam, We wish to inform you that Zydus Sunshine Lifesciences (Pvt) Ltd, the proposed joint venture between Zydus Lifesciences Limited (Zydus) and Sunshine Healthcare, part of Sunshine Holdings PLC, signed an agreement with the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka on 13 October 2026 to establish a pharmaceutical manufacturing facility in the BOI zone in Horana, Sri Lanka. Both companies had announced the formation of a Joint Venture on 26 June 2026. The project envisages a phased investment of over USD 20 million. The facility will be developed on a site of nearly four acres, with commercial operations expected to commence in 2028, subject to project timelines and relevant regulatory approvals. In its first phase, the facility will manufacture oral solid dosage forms for the Sri Lankan market. Exchange Plaza, Plot No. C/1, G Block, Phiroze Jeejeebhoy Towers, Bandra Kurla Complex, Dalal Street, Bandra (E), Mumbai – 400051 Mumbai - 400 001 Subject: Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 – Press Release on new order book secured by Almondz Global Infra Consultant Limited, a Step-down subsidiary of the Company Dear Sir / Madam, Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations”), we wish to inform you that Almondz Global Infra - Consultant Limited (“AGICL”), a Step-Down Subsidiary of the Company, has more than doubled its new order book in the 1st Half year 2026-27 over the previous 1st Half year 2025-26. AGICL has secured new order book of Rs. 154 crores in the 1st Half year as on 30 September 2026-27, as against Rs. 72 crores in the 1st Half year as on 30 September 2025-26, representing growth of approximately 214%. With this, the Total orders book of AGICL have crossed Rs.400 crores as on September 30,2026. The new orders will be executed over a period of three years’ time. The details required under the SEBI Listing Regulations read with the applicable SEBI circulars are given in Annexure A to this letter. A copy of the press release being issued by the Company in this regard is enclosed as Annexure B. The press release is also being made available on the website of the Company at www.avonmorecapital.in You are requested to kindly take the above information on record.
